goal: Cut runner minutes of the open-tennis-robots cad job with identical outputs and unchanged test pass/fail conditions.
notes: Metric: open-tennis-robots CAD suite wall and CPU, plus feeder package build wall. Before (main, same 4-core sandbox, build123d 0.13.0 venv): feeder build 116.1/115.6 s (`time python -m otr_cad feeder --out d`); suite 281 s wall via a per-test timing runner, 289 s / user 9m28s via `time python -m unittest discover -s tests`. After: feeder build 98.5/97.8 s; suite 229 s wall, user 7m09s, 148 tests OK (147 + new CrossClashesTest) incl. both committed-package freshness checks. Lift pose test 51.3 -> 14.4 s, deck-cable pose test 18.7 -> 9.2 s. Output check: diff -r of feeder package folders main vs branch identical. Changes: placed solids built once per cached parts list and exact bboxes memoised for them (feeder.py _placed_named, bbox); package.cross_clashes; two pose tests intersect stationary parts' own pairs once. Local checks: see run_workflow_locally output summary in PR. CI cad job expected ~50 s shorter per run.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
